analyzed_vuln.description: UA_Server_new double-frees/uses a stale nodestore context on init failure. It creates config.nodestore via UA_Nodestore_HashMap, then calls UA_Server_newWithConfig(&config). When initialization fails, UA_Server_init -> UA_Server_delete -> UA_ServerConfig_clean already invokes config->nodestore.clear(context), freeing the UA_NodeMap. After UA_Server_newWithConfig returns NULL, UA_Server_new incorrectly calls config.nodestore.clear(config.nodestore.context) again, causing heap-use-after-free in UA_NodeMap_delete (reads ns->size from freed UA_NodeMap).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In fuzz_binary_message, even tiny/invalid input can make server initialization fail early (UA_Server_newWithConfig returns NULL). Data flow: harness calls UA_Server_new() unconditionally; UA_Server_new sets up default nodestore, passes config by value into server, and on failure performs an extra nodestore.clear on the original config. Because the first cleanup already freed the same nodestore context during UA_Server_delete, the second clear triggers UAF/double-free path in UA_NodeMap_delete.
